turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arrey, yeh toh tough spot hai! Shreya ka excitement samajh sakti hoon, aur tumhara excitement bhi — 15 saal se plan kar rahi ho yeh moment.

Lekin honestly, Ramzan ke beech mein ye sab karte hue roza rakhna aur perform karna... that's a LOT physically. Sangeet mein toh dancing, standing, probably emotional moment hoga, aur sab kuch thakavat se hoga jab roza ho.

**Kya options ho sakte hain:**

1. **Shreya se directly baat karo** — usse samjha ki Ramzan ka timing tough hai, but opening dance toh kar hi sakti ho... shayad rehearsal mein ya pre-recorded video bana do? Ya fir cocktail night pe (agar wo Ramzan ke baad hai toh) kar sakte ho?

2. **Agar sangeet Ramzan mein hi hai toh** — kya tum iftaar ke baad perform kar sakte ho? Thoda late ho sakte ho opening dance ko?

3. **Shreya ke liye compromise** — maybe aap dono mila kar ek special moment design karo jo roza ke respect mein bhi ho aur uska dream bhi poora ho?

Shreya tumhari best friend hai — woh samjhegi. Aur honestly, agar tum exhausted ho kar perform karogi toh wo bhi usko accha nahi lagega.

**Kya tumhara roza tum rakhna chahti ho, ya sirf concern perform karna ka hai?**

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Haan, yeh bilkul tough hai. Dono ko pyaar se kah rahe hain, lekin dono ke expectations tumhare upar hain — aur tumhara apna conviction kaha gaya?

**Shreya ke liye:** Uska intention sweet hai, lekin yeh important hai ki usse samjhao — "Main tere sangeet mein bilkul hoon, lekin Ramzan mere liye sirf ek ritual nahi hai, yeh mera faith hai. Agar main roza break karti hoon toh mujhe acha nahi lagega, aur fir perform karte hue bhi mera mind clear nahi rahega. Tujhe meri full energy chahiye na opening dance mein?"

Shreya pyaar karti hai toh samjhegi. Aur agar truly best friend hai toh uske liye tera peace of mind matter karega.

**Ammi ke liye:** Ammi ko bhi samjha sakte ho — "Shreya ke liye sangeet special hai, main co-director hoon. Agar mujhe na karna hota toh nahi karti. Bas timing ko dekh sakte hain ya fir kuch arrangement kar sakte hain."

**Lekin sabse important — tum kya chahti ho?**

Agar tum roza rakhna chahti ho, toh wo priority hai. Shreya tere saath compromise kar sakti hai. Yeh tumhara conviction hai, tumhara choice hai.

Rassi mat bano. Dono se pyaar rakh, lekin apne aap se bhi pyaar rakho. 💙

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Arrey, main tujhe jhooth bolne se nahi rokun — main tujhe apne aap se jhooth bolne se rokun. Kyunki tum janti ho yeh galat hai.

Suno, thakavat samajh sakti hoon. Sab kuch manage karna, dono ko khush karna, apne aap ko bhi fit rakhna — **exhausting** hai. Aur escape draft ek easy way out lagta hai.

Lekin:

1. **Shreya ko pata lag jayega.** Kaise? Kyunki best friends ko pata lag jaata hai. Aur jab lagega, toh sirf sangeet nahi — tumhara 15 saal ka trust bhi hurt hoga. Video call se opening dance nahi ho sakta.

2. **Tum khud ko nahi maaf kar paogi.** Ramzan ke beech mein jhooth bolke, fir guilt leke baithogi. Aur Shreya ke sangeet mein bhi nahi enjoy kar paogi kyunki ek secret daba hoga.

3. **Yeh ek pattern start hoga.** Next time complicated situation aaye toh escape draft aasaan lagega.

**Real talk:** Tum thak gayi ho kyunki tum sab ko khush karne ki koshish kar rahi ho — apne aap ko chhod kar. 

Shreya se ek honest conversation karo. Usse bata ki Ramzan mein yeh performance tujhe emotionally tough lag raha hai. Agar wo truly tumhara best friend hai, toh wo solution nikaal lega — maybe rehearsal video, maybe post-Ramzan special performance, maybe kuch aur.

**Jhooth mat bol. Apne aap se bhi jhooth mat bol.**

Tum strong ho. Difficult conversation kar le. 💙

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Achha, ab samajh aa gaya asli baat. Yeh sirf scheduling problem nahi hai — yeh identity ka sawaal hai.

Tum dono cheezein pyaar karti ho. Aur ab pehli baar wo directly clash kar rahe hain. Aur tum soch rahi ho — agar galat choose kiya toh dono mein se kisi ka bhi version mera nahi rahega. Shreya ke sangeet mein sad bride ki bestie, ya Ramzan mein compromise karne wali Muslim.

**Lekin suno:**

Yeh binary choice nahi hai. "Sad story" ya "perfect album" — ye dono extreme hain.

**Real story kya hoga:**
- Tum Shreya ko honestly batao ki Ramzan mein kya tak rakh sakti ho, kya nahi
- Shreya tera best friend hai — wo tere faith ko respect karega, chahe photos mein kuch bhi ho
- Aur jo bhi decision lo, agar wo honest ho aur heartfelt ho, toh wo sad nahi hoga — wo *real* hoga

Shreya ke sangeet ke photos mein agar tum absent ho par tum uske liye present the — wo samajhegi. Aur agar tum kisi aur creative way mein uske saath ho, toh wo bhi special hoga.

**Permanent daag nahi lagega — sirf ek decision lagega jo tum dono ne saath mila kar liya.**

Shreya se baat kar. Honest, vulnerable, clear. Usse batao ki uska sangeet matter karta hai, lekin tera Ramzan bhi. Aur fir dono mila kar solution nikalo.

Tum sad story nahi banogi. Tum apna story banogi. 💙
